simple.summary: אַרְכֻבָה (ʼarkubâh) means the knee First listed occurrence: Dan 5 6.

definitions.full: H755. arkubah [ אַרְכֻבָּה ] noun feminine id. (by transposition; compare ᵑ7 רְכוּבָא, ᵑ7 J אַרְכּוּבְתָּא ; Christian-Palestinian Aramaic Schw Idioticon 89 (who > explained from √ רכב , compare Schulth Lex.194 ); Arabic id. ); — plural suffix אַרְכֻבָּתֵהּ Dan 5:6 his knees .
definitions.rootNote: (Aramaic) from an unused root corresponding to 7392 (in the sense of bending the knee);
